683:t_000:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$ＡＧ$$! How is activation of the $$時空震動弾$$ coming along?!」

683:t_000:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There are no problems! Its link with $$ソーラリアン$$'s $$Ｚクリスタル$$ is working smoothly too!」

683:t_000:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Now we just have to protect $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 until detonation!」

683:t_000:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Be careful! The $$宇宙怪獣$$ are coming!」

683:t_001:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「I knew it, but that's still one hell of a lot of them!」

683:t_001:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「But this isn't their main force either.」

683:t_001:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「So even greater numbers are waiting behind them.」

683:t_001:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「Then we need only crush this vanguard!」

683:t_001:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「There are $$変動重力源$$ types like the one we fought on Earth too!」

683:t_001:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The evolved $$宇宙怪獣$$... So they did appear.」

683:t_001:6.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We'll handle the gravitational collapse when they're shot down with $$ソーラリアン$$'s dimensional transfer barrier system.」

683:t_001:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll concentrate entirely on taking them down!」

683:t_001:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「Will $$ノノ$$ be all right on her own?」

683:t_001:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「She asked to deploy alone. We have to respect her decision.」

683:t_001:13.en:
$n
「She's a $$バスターマシン$$ made to fight the $$宇宙怪獣$$. She'll come through for us.」

683:t_001:14.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「I'll confirm the operation once more. Our objective is strictly to defend $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3.」

683:t_002:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「If the enemy enters this area, we're done... The $$時空震動弾$$ could detonate before it's fully ready and go out of control.」

683:t_002:1.en:
$$桂$$
「If things go badly, we could have another $$大時空震動$$...」

683:t_002:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There are seven minutes until the $$時空震動弾$$ detonates!」

683:t_002:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「If we protect $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 for these seven minutes... humanity wins!」

683:t_002:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Seven minutes... The future lies beyond them.」

683:t_002:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「These look like they'll be the longest seven minutes of my life.」

683:t_003:0.en:
$$ニア$$
「The $$宇宙怪獣$$ are heading toward us! The large ones seem to be targeting the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3!」

683:t_003:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do this, everyone! Winning just by holding out for seven minutes sounds easy!」

683:t_003:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah! I don't know about the will of the universe or whatever, but don't think you can take us out in just seven minutes!」

683:t_003:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「In this situation, it's fortunate that $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 is smaller than the original.」

683:t_003:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So the wind's blowing our way! We can do this!」

683:t_003:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But we don't know what will happen next. Don't wait for the $$宇宙怪獣$$! Take the fight to them!」

683:t_003:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Here I go...! I'll do this!」

683:t_003:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「We'll protect them, no matter what! $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3, and the universe!」

683:t_003:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Whatever happens, we have seven minutes left...!」

683:t_003:11.en:
$n
「We'll put everything we have on the line!」

683:t_003:12.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, begin the attack! We will win!」

683:t_003:13.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Now we'll gather everyone's flames into one mighty blaze!」

683:t_003:14.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll light the future with its radiance!」

683:t_003:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
(I'm waiting for you, Big Sis...)

683:t_003:16.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
(I'm waiting for you, Big Sis...)

683:t_003:17.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
(I'm waiting for you, Big Sis...)

683:t_004:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「All right! We've driven off the first wave!」

683:t_004:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Is the main force coming next?!」

683:t_005:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Four minutes have elapsed since the operation began!」

683:t_005:1.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Three minutes remain until the $$時空震動弾$$ detonates!」

683:t_005:2.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Let's do this! We'll hold them off all the way!」

683:t_006:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「I've detected gravitational tremors! The main force is probably warping in!」

683:t_006:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「I've been waiting! We'll smash it and finish this!」

683:t_009:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Even so, it's way too damn big!」

683:t_009:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Is this... a single living creature...?」

683:t_009:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Even I didn't anticipate something like that appearing!」

683:t_009:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「That thing...! A gravitational collapse on an unimaginable scale is starting inside its body!」

683:t_009:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「If things go badly, even the $$時空震動弾$$ may not be able to send it into the space between dimensions!」

683:t_009:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「Damn it! Why the hell did something like that have to appear?!」

683:t_009:11.en:
???
「Earth's humanity is the root of it all.」

683:t_010:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I welcome you from the bottom of my heart, and rejoice in our reunion.」

683:t_010:5.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「You still don't understand the Captain's... Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s power, do you, $n?」

683:t_010:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! What did you mean by what you just said?!」

683:t_010:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Exactly what I said. Earth's humanity created the $$宇宙怪獣$$ you call $$変動重力源$$s.」

683:t_010:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The source of the gravitational collapse inside it is a degeneracy reactor created by Earth's humanity in a certain world.」

683:t_010:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Yes... $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$... That $$変動重力源$$ is a space monster that evolved by swallowing your world's technology.」

683:t_010:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Furthermore, the gigantic $$変動重力源$$ before you has absorbed an $$ヱクセリヲン$$-class degeneracy reactor.」
